normalization: None: every case exchange and entity is retained literally; credentials/private setup entities excluded at acquisition.

metadata.acquisitionVariant: Published CLI 0.5.6 acquires only the private lab administrator context. Published TeamCityClient performs owned requests. Private Basic bootstrap only issues one scoped PAT; credential entities are omitted. Fixed byte GET follows the same pinned file path/query/Accept as client download. Not an unchanged CLI story acceptance.
limits: All Users inherited rights are observed, not changed. Scoped PAT restrictions bound P and Agent controls; this is not proof of target OIDC/JWT, permission withdrawal or a new authorization policy.
One owned Linux Agent and simpleRunner process, not Windows/T3 or production Vivarium.
